name: redash
description_en: Make Your Company Data Driven. Connect to any data source, easily visualize, dashboard and share your data.
readme_excerpt: Redash is designed to enable anyone, regardless of the level of technical sophistication, to harness the power of data big and small. SQL users leverage Redash to explore, query, visualize, and share data from any data source. Their work, in turn, enables anybody in their organization to use the data.
